ui.app.name: Tröskel

ui.athletes.subtitle: Your athletes and their basic data. Height is needed to convert the image to centimetres.
ui.athletes.empty: Pick an athlete in the list, or add a new one.

ui.athletes.max_hr_hint: Leave empty if unknown. A max HR test fills it in.
ui.athletes.delete_confirm:
Erase {name} completely?

All tests, films, key frames and saved reports about {name} are removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.
ui.athletes.err_name: Enter at least a first name.
ui.athletes.err_height: Height must be between 100 and 230 cm.
ui.athletes.err_maxhr: Max heart rate must be between 120 and 230 bpm.
ui.athletes.err_resthr: Resting heart rate must be lower than max heart rate.
ui.athletes.err_birth: The date of birth cannot be read. Write it as YYYY-MM-DD or YYMMDD, or leave it empty.

ui.wiz.subtitle: A few short steps. Everything can be changed before you start.
ui.wiz.athlete_sub: Pick the athlete. Double-click to go straight on.
ui.wiz.kind_sub: Combined gives both the lactate curve and the running technique in one session.
ui.wiz.protocol_sub: Start from a ready protocol and adjust it for the athlete.
ui.wiz.pause_hint: 0 = the sample is taken while running.
ui.wiz.camera_sub: Pick the source and the side the camera films from.
ui.wiz.gopro_check: No GoPro? Check that it is switched on, that the USB mode is GoPro Connect, not MTP (under Connections in the camera's preferences), that the cable is firmly in at both ends and that the camera shows the USB icon on its screen. Then press Search again.
ui.wiz.choose_camera: Pick a camera in the list
ui.wiz.view_hint: From the side: overstride, shin angle and trunk. From behind: pelvic drop and knee valgus.
ui.wiz.treadmill_sub: How the program controls the speed.
ui.wiz.hr_sub: Search for straps nearby. Ask the athlete to moisten the strap first.
ui.wiz.framing_sub: The whole body must be inside the frame, from head to feet, also in the flight phase.
ui.wiz.need_treadmill: Connect the treadmill or choose Manual.
ui.kind.gait.desc: A few speeds of 120 s with the camera
ui.kind.lactate.desc: 4 min stages with blood samples: LT1, LT2 and zones
ui.kind.max_hr.desc: Ramp until the athlete cannot go on
ui.kind.combined.desc: Lactate steps and running technique in one test
ui.kind.max_hr_gait.desc: Max HR ramp with camera, technique judged before the end
ui.recover.title: Interrupted test
ui.recover.ask: A test was interrupted at {time} ({name}, {protocol}). Everything saved until then is kept. Open it?
ui.recover.more: {n} more are in History, marked as interrupted.
ui.recover.resume_how: Connect the treadmill, the heart rate strap and the camera in the wizard and start. The test then continues from the next stage with the same protocol and is saved in the same test. The test and protocol chosen in the wizard are not used this time.
ui.recover.banner_interrupted: The test was interrupted at {time}: the program closed unexpectedly or the power went. Everything saved until then is shown.
ui.recover.banner_stopped: The test was stopped at {time} before it was complete.
ui.recover.video_lost: The film from before the interruption could not be read.
ui.recover.no_resume: This test cannot be continued: a max HR test is not valid after a break, and after 20 minutes the athlete is no longer warmed up. Run a new test if needed.
ui.res.gait_window_hr: Running technique is judged on the film up to and including the first {n} stages of the ramp (up to {last}), where heart rate was below 90 % of the peak, {hr} bpm. The last minutes towards exhaustion are left out.
ui.res.gait_window_count: Running technique is judged on the film up to and including the first {n} stages of the ramp (up to {last}). Heart rate is missing, so the last three stages towards exhaustion are left out.
ui.res.gait_window_warmup: Running technique is judged on the warm-up: already the first stage of the ramp was above 90 % of the peak heart rate.
ui.mode.ftms.desc: The program controls the treadmill directly
ui.mode.qz.desc: Control through the QZ app on the same network
ui.mode.manual.desc: You set the speed, the program tells you when
ui.mode.sim.desc: To try the program. Not a real test: marked in the results and the report
ui.dev.none_found: Nothing found. Is the device on and close?
ui.dev.pick_first: Pick a treadmill in the list
ui.dev.no_hr_chosen: The test runs without heart rate
ui.check.height_ok: Height {h} cm, the image can be converted to centimetres
ui.check.height_missing: Height missing: add it under Athletes
ui.check.maxhr_ok: Max HR {n}, HR zones shown live
ui.check.maxhr_missing: Max HR missing: heart rate shown without zone colour
ui.check.no_camera: No camera: the test runs without technique
ui.check.hr_ok: The heart rate strap is connected
ui.check.framing: The athlete is fully inside the frame on the left
ui.guide.head: HEAD HERE
ui.video.no_camera_test: The test runs without a camera
ui.live.stop_confirm: Stop the test now? Completed stages are saved.
ui.live.exhausted_tip: The athlete cannot go on. The test ends and counts as completed.
ui.live.start_now_tip: The warm-up is enough. The first stage starts at once.
ui.live.start_speed_tip: Moves every stage by the same amount.
ui.live.keep_going: Keep going as long as you can
ui.live.take_lactate_sub: Type the value on the laptop when it is ready
ui.live.set_speed_sub: Incline {incline} %. Then press Treadmill is set.
ui.live.paused_sub: Press Resume when you are ready
ui.live.finished: Well done! The test is complete
ui.gaitx.overstride_cm: How far in front of the hip the foot lands. A long overstride brakes every step and loads the knee.
ui.gaitx.shin_angle_deg: Shin angle at foot strike. A shin leaning forward means the foot lands too far ahead.
ui.gaitx.trunk_lean_deg: How much the trunk leans forward. A slight lean from the ankles is efficient.
ui.gaitx.vertical_oscillation_cm: How much the body bounces up and down. A lot of bounce costs energy.
ui.gaitx.cadence_spm: Steps per minute. A higher cadence usually means shorter steps and less overstride.
ui.gaitx.pelvic_drop_deg: How much the hip drops on the opposite side in stance. Much drop suggests weak glutes.
ui.rpe.hint: Ask: How hard does it feel right now?
ui.res.preview_external: The report is shown in the computer's PDF program.
ui.res.preview_no_program: No program could show the PDF. Save it as PDF and open it.
ui.res.max_edit_tip: The max HR the zones build on. The test's max HR is the highest 5-second mean. Change it and the zones and the watch values are worked out again, and it is saved as the athlete's max HR.
ui.res.max_set_note: The max HR {v} was changed by hand in the result.
ui.res.stages_hint: Double-click lactate or RPE to correct a value. The curve updates at once.
ui.res.bad_value: That value cannot be used. Lactate 0.1–30 mmol/L, RPE 6–20.
ui.res.no_gait: No running technique in this test.
ui.res.video_ready: The video from the test is saved. A detailed analysis gives stills with the issues marked for the report.
ui.res.analyze_now: Analyse the video now? It takes a few minutes and you can keep working meanwhile.
ui.res.analysis_unavailable: Video analysis is not available in this version.
ui.res.uncertain: Uncertain: the film's frame rate is too low for a reliable value. The warnings are at the top of this tab.
ui.hist.subtitle: All tests per athlete. Select two or more lactate tests to compare them, or several tests for a combined report.
ui.hist.collected_tip: One report for the selected tests, e.g. a lactate test, a max HR test and running technique the same day
ui.set.subtitle: Changes are saved at once.
ui.set.branding_sub: Shown on the TV and in the report.
ui.set.contact_hint: Phone, e-mail and web. Printed at the bottom of the report.
ui.set.logo_hint: PNG or SVG, ideally with a transparent background.
ui.set.language_hint: Applies to the program and the report.
ui.set.restart_needed: The change applies when you restart the program.
ui.set.tv_hint: F11 toggles full screen, Esc leaves full screen.
ui.set.screen_auto: Automatic (the second screen if there is one)
ui.set.sound: Sound signal before each stage change
ui.set.no_printers: No printer found. Save as PDF instead, or add a printer in Windows.
ui.set.data_sub: Athletes, tests and reports are kept in a folder on this computer.
ui.set.move_confirm:
Move everything to {path}?

Everything is copied there and checked. The program then closes, and the old folder is emptied when you start the program again.
ui.set.backup_hint: The backup is encrypted with your password and holds everything except the video files. Keep it on a USB stick that is locked away. Without the password it cannot be opened.
ui.set.demo_on: Demo mode is on: treadmill, heart rate and camera are simulated.
ui.err.unexpected: Something went wrong in the program.
ui.err.unexpected_sub: What happened is saved in the log ({path}). A running test continues if possible. Please send the log to support.

ui.live.recovery_banner_sub: Measuring how fast your heart rate drops
ui.live.final_sprint_tip: Raise the speed for a last sprint before the athlete is completely spent. At the belt's highest speed the incline rises instead.
ui.live.sprint_before: Final sprint: starts when the heart rate has levelled off (rose at most {limit} beats over the last minute), at the earliest {min} into the ramp, and at the latest {after} into the ramp
ui.live.sprint_wait: Final sprint: heart rate {rise} beats over the last minute (starts at {limit} or less, at the earliest {min} into the ramp) · at the latest in {left}
ui.live.sprint_wait_nohr: Final sprint: no heart rate over the last minute (starts when it rose {limit} beats or less, at the earliest {min} into the ramp) · at the latest in {left}
ui.live.sprint_started: The final sprint started {at} into the ramp ({why})
ui.wiz.warmup_hint: Part of the test. A lactate sample after the warm-up gives the resting value.
ui.res.method_tip: Recommended picks the method that suits the curve best. Change it to compare with other labs.
ui.res.comment_hint: The key take-away for the athlete, in your own words.
ui.res.maybe_not_max: The test probably did not reach max heart rate
ui.check.framing_ok: The athlete is fully inside the frame
ui.check.framing_bad: The athlete is outside the frame: move the camera or zoom out
ui.check.framing_unknown: No runner in the picture yet
ui.wiz.model_download: Downloading the body tracking model (first time only) …
ui.err.model:
The model could not be downloaded. Check the internet connection. The test can still run, but without skeleton and technique.

ui.app.already_running: Tröskel is already running. Look for its window in the taskbar.
ui.tests.title: The tests
ui.tests.subtitle: What each test measures, how it is done, by which standard and what you get. Print the sheet About the tests and hand it to a client.
ui.res.vo2_none: Cannot be estimated from this test. It takes a test to the limit (press Exhausted), at least three stages of three minutes with heart rate and a known max heart rate, or the athlete's max and resting heart rate.
ui.res.zone_system_tip: The same thresholds are shown in the system you choose. The report uses the same choice.
ui.res.watch_none: A max heart rate is needed to work out values for the watch.
ui.erase.running: A test is running for {name}. End the test first.
ui.erase.title: Erased
ui.erase.done: {name} is erased: {sessions} tests and {files} files were removed.
ui.erase.left_title: The program cannot reach this. Remove it yourself:
ui.erase.left.report: Report that is no longer where it was saved, or that you just saved: {path}
ui.erase.left.extract: Extract that is no longer where it was saved: {path}
ui.erase.left.export: Export that may contain the person: {path}
ui.erase.left.safety: The program's own copy {path} is removed by itself on {until}.
ui.erase.left_always: Printouts on paper, reports sent by e-mail or copied somewhere else, older backups and film on the camera's memory card.
ui.erase.restore_note: If an older backup is restored, the person is removed again automatically.
ui.set.video_retention_hint: The key frames and the measurements are always kept. The film is only needed for a new analysis.
ui.res.video_removed: The film was removed on {date} according to the film setting. The key frames and the measurements remain.
ui.athletes.extract_tip: Everything stored about the person in one zip file: a readable summary, all measurements, the films, the key frames and the reports. Used when the person asks for an extract.
ui.consent.title: Consent
ui.consent.hint: Fill in from the signed form. The boxes decide what the program does: without film nothing is recorded, without keep everything is erased when the report has been handed over, and without contact nothing is mailed. The report and the FIT file are sent by ordinary e-mail, which is not encrypted.
ui.consent.withdraw_confirm:
Has {name} withdrawn their consent?

Then everything about {name} is erased: tests, films, key frames and saved reports. This cannot be undone.
ui.consent.err_date: The consent date cannot be read. Write it as 2026-11-14.
ui.consent.ask_test:
{name} has no registered consent to test and measurements.

Fill in the consent under Athletes from the signed form. Start the test anyway?
ui.consent.no_film: {name} has not consented to film. The test runs without recording: the live image is shown but not saved, and there will be no key frames.
ui.consent.erase_after_report:
{name} has not consented to the results being kept.

Has {name} received their report? Then everything about {name} is erased now. The report you just saved stays.
ui.res.no_film_consent: No film was recorded: there was no consent to film.
ui.set.move_done: Everything is copied to {path}. The program closes now. Start it again and the old folder is emptied.
ui.set.busy_test: A test is running. End the test first.
ui.set.backup_password_hint: At least {n} characters. Write the password down and keep it somewhere else than the backup: without it the backup cannot be opened.
ui.set.password_mismatch: The passwords are not the same.
ui.set.restore_done: The backup is restored. Restart the program.
ui.set.export_warn: The file is not encrypted and holds names, heart rate and lactate. Choose one person if you do not need all, and remove the file when you are done.
ui.lock.title: Tröskel is locked
ui.lock.card_sub: So that the next customer does not see the previous one. The PIN protects the screen, not the files on the computer.
ui.lock.pin_on: A PIN is required to open the program.
ui.lock.pin_off: No PIN: the program opens without a lock.
ui.lock.pin_short: The PIN must have at least {n} characters.
ui.lock.pin_mismatch: The PINs are not the same.
ui.lock.pin_forgot: If you forget the PIN: start the program once with --reset-pin.
ui.lock.idle_hint: Applies when there is a PIN. The program never locks while a test is running.
ui.lock.customer_mode: Customer mode: hide the athlete list and the history while a test is running
ui.remind.banner: {n} athletes need a review: the data is not to be kept longer than necessary.
ui.remind.old: The latest test was on {date}, more than 24 months ago. Erase the person, or ask for a new consent at the next test.
ui.remind.no_store: {name} has not consented to the results being kept, and has tests from {date}. Erase the person when the report has been handed over.
ui.athletes.email_hint: Optional. The report and the FIT file can be mailed here when the box Contact about follow-up is ticked in the consent.
ui.athletes.err_email: The e-mail address cannot be read. Write it as name@example.com, or leave it empty.
ui.res.fit_tip: The test as a workout, for Strava and Garmin Connect
ui.fit.no_samples: The test has no saved time series (heart rate and load per second), so there is no FIT file.
ui.err.fit: The FIT file could not be saved: {detail}
ui.mail.title: Send to the athlete
ui.mail.subject: Subject
ui.mail.warn: Ordinary e-mail is not encrypted, and the report has no password. Check the address: a sent mail cannot be taken back.
ui.mail.warn_plan: Ordinary e-mail is not encrypted, and the plan is not password protected. Check the address: a mail that has been sent cannot be taken back.
ui.mail.block.no_athlete: The test is not saved on an athlete.
ui.mail.block.no_address: {name} has no e-mail address. Fill it in under Athletes.
ui.mail.block.no_consent: {name} has not ticked Contact about follow-up in the consent. Without it no e-mail is sent.
ui.mail.block.not_set_up: E-mail is not set up. Do it under Settings → E-mail.
ui.erase.left.fit: FIT file that is not where it was saved: {path}
ui.set.mail_sub: The account the reports are mailed from, for example a Gmail of its own for the business. The default suits Gmail: turn on 2-step verification and create an app password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords.
ui.set.mail_password_saved: Saved. Type a new one to change it
ui.set.mail_password_unreadable: Cannot be read on this PC. Type it again
ui.set.mail_password_failed: The password could not be stored protected ({detail}). Nothing was saved.
ui.set.mail_sender_address_hint: Leave empty when the user is an e-mail address.
ui.set.mail_test_tip: Sends a mail from the account to an address you choose
ui.set.mail_test_to_hint: An inbox you can read. Gmail shows a mail to the account itself under Sent only.
ui.set.mail_test_ok: The test mail was sent to {address}. Check that it arrived.
ui.set.mail_unencrypted: The password is stored encrypted and can only be read on this PC. The connection to the server is encrypted, but ordinary e-mail is not encrypted all the way to the reader: only mail people who ticked Contact about follow-up.
ui.set.belt_hint: Enter what the treadmill can do, for example 18 km/h and 12 %. QZ cannot read it, and the ramp of the max test goes on with the speed when the incline is at its top.
ui.res.keep_max_q: The test's peak heart rate {peak} is lower than your saved max heart rate {saved}. Keep {saved}?\n\nYes keeps {saved}. No changes it to {peak} (max heart rate falls with age).
ui.wiz.ramp_up_speed: {step} km/h {per} up to the belt's highest speed ({kmh} km/h)
ui.wiz.ramp_up_incline: {step} % {per} up to the belt's highest incline ({pct} %)
ui.wiz.ramp_then_incline: and then {step} % {per} up to the highest incline ({pct} %)
ui.wiz.ramp_then_speed: and then {step} km/h {per} up to the highest speed ({kmh} km/h)
ui.wiz.ramp_expected: From the previous test: the ramp will probably take {min} min.
ui.wiz.ramp_long: The ramp will probably be longer than 12 min. A max test should take 8–12 min: raise the start speed.
ui.wiz.ramp_short: The ramp will probably be shorter than 6 min. A max test should take 8–12 min: lower the start speed.
ui.wiz.sprint_hint: Starts by itself when the heart rate has levelled off (after at least 4 min of ramp) or after 12 min of ramp, and is the last step of the ramp. Nobody needs to press anything.
ui.athletes.max_test_due: The latest max test was on {date}, more than {years} years ago. Max heart rate falls with age: do a new max test.
ui.wiz.prev_long_incline: The previous test took {min} min and reached {pct} %: choose the speed ramp or +1 km/h.
ui.wiz.prev_long: The previous test took {min} min: raise the start speed by 1 km/h.
ui.wiz.prev_short: The previous test took only {min} min: lower the start speed by 1 km/h.
ui.athletes.watch_vo2max_hint: Optional. The report shows it next to the test's estimate.
ui.athletes.err_watch_vo2max: VO2max from the watch must be between 15 and 95 ml/kg/min.
ui.athletes.err_watch_date: The date of the watch's VO2max cannot be read. Write it as 2026-11-14, or leave it empty.
ui.res.peak_not_max: Peak heart rate in the test
ui.kind.hr_zones.desc: No lactate: speed for your zones and max heart rate
ui.chart.no_steps: No steps with a settled heart rate yet
ui.res.hr_speed_hint: The dots are the heart rate of the last minute of each step. The line gives the speed for the zones, dashed where it goes outside the steps.
ui.res.stages_hint_hr: The heart rate is the mean of the last minute of the step. If it rises more than 3 beats in that minute it has not settled.
ui.res.relation_none: Too few steps with a settled heart rate
ui.res.gait_window_steps_hr: The running technique is judged on the film up to and including the first {n} stages of the test (up to {last}), where the heart rate was below 90 % of the peak, {hr} bpm. The last minutes towards exhaustion are not included.
ui.wiz.gait_rule: Running technique needs an even speed and incline for at least 60 s per stage. Choose a protocol that meets that, or do the tests one at a time.
ui.wiz.film_hint: You then choose a camera in the next step. The technique is judged on the stages before the end.
ui.wiz.add_phone_tip: The phone or a network camera as a camera: enter the address the app shows, or search the network.
ui.wiz.cam_remove_ask: Remove {name} from the camera list? The address and the password are forgotten.
ui.wiz.camera2_hint: Two cameras film at the same time, for example the GoPro from the side and the phone from behind. Each camera gets its own measures.
ui.wiz.demo_camera2: Demo runner from behind (no camera needed)
ui.err.camera2_start: The second camera could not be started, the test runs with one camera: {detail}
ui.gaitx.knee_valgus_deg: How far the knee falls inwards in stance. A lot of it loads the knee and points to weak hips.
ui.gaitx.step_width_cm: The sideways distance between the foot strikes. Feet that cross the midline load the hip and the shin.
ui.gaitx.arm_cross_cm: How far the hand passes the body's midline. Arms that cross rotate the trunk and cost energy.
ui.res.view_sync: {n} of {of} steps were found in both films. This camera was {ms} ms behind the first.
ui.stream.title: Add a phone or a network camera
ui.stream.intro: Start the camera app on the phone and let it send on Wi-Fi. The phone and the computer must be on the same network. Type the address the app shows. The IP address is enough, for example 192.0.2.50: the program then tries the usual ports.
ui.stream.needs_login: needs a login: type the user name and password
ui.stream.hint: Nothing found: check that the app is running and sending, that the phone has not gone to sleep and that it is on the same Wi-Fi as the computer. When the app needs a login, the fields for the user name and password are shown.
ui.stream.saved: Saved address. Try it again, or save
ui.stream.login_given: the login is tried in the preview
ui.stream.login_first: Type the user name and password first
ui.athletes.max_hr_sport_hint: Leave empty if it has not been measured in the sport. Max HR is lower on a bike and in double poling than in running, by an amount that differs between people, so the running value is never used here.
ui.check.maxhr_missing_sport: Max HR in this sport is missing: the heart rate is shown without zone colour. The running max HR is not used.
ui.check.weight_missing: The body weight is missing: W/kg cannot be computed
ui.check.apps_closed.bike: Zwift, QZ and other training apps must be closed during the test
ui.check.apps_closed.skierg: ErgZone and ErgData must be closed during the test, and the monitor is on Just Ski
ui.err.ergometer:
The device could not be connected. Check that it is on and that no other app is connected.

ui.hist.collect_one_sport: Choose tests in the same sport. Zones and max HR are per sport, so running, cycling and SkiErg are never merged.
ui.kind.bike.lactate.desc: 5 min stages in watt with blood samples; gives LT1, LT2 and zones for cycling
ui.kind.bike.ramp.desc: More watt every minute until the rider cannot go on: max HR on the bike, best one-minute power and FTP
ui.kind.bike.ftp.desc: 20 min as hard as possible at an even effort. FTP is 95 % of the mean power
ui.kind.skierg.lactate.desc: 4 min stages in watt with blood samples; gives LT1, LT2 and zones for SkiErg
ui.kind.skierg.ramp.desc: A higher target every minute until the athlete cannot go on: highest heart rate in double poling and best one-minute power
ui.mode.bike.ftms.desc: The program holds the power on the trainer (ERG mode)
ui.mode.bike.manual.desc: The rider holds the power, the program says when
ui.mode.bike.sim.desc: For trying the program. Not a real test: marked in the result and the report
ui.mode.skierg.pm5.desc: The program reads watt, stroke rate and pace from the monitor. The athlete holds the target shown
ui.mode.skierg.manual.desc: No connection: the athlete holds the target, no readings from the monitor
ui.mode.skierg.sim.desc: For trying the program. Not a real test: marked in the result and the report
ui.wiz.ergometer_sub.run: How the program controls the speed.
ui.wiz.ergometer_sub.bike: How the program controls the power. Close Zwift, QZ and other training apps first.
ui.wiz.ergometer_sub.skierg: A SkiErg cannot be set: the screen shows the target and the program reads what the athlete holds. Close ErgZone and ErgData first.
ui.wiz.need_bike: Connect the trainer or choose Manual.
ui.wiz.need_skierg: Connect the SkiErg's monitor or choose Manual.
ui.wiz.need_weight: The body weight is needed for W/kg.
ui.wiz.weight_ask: Today's body weight in kg (for W/kg):
ui.live.low_cadence_sub: Below 50 rpm the trainer cannot hold the power.
ui.live.off_target: Off the target: more than 5 % away
ui.res.mean20_line: Mean power over 20 minutes: {w} W, mean heart rate {hr} bpm.
ui.res.ftp_note: FTP is an estimate with an error of about 3–5 % and is not the same number as LT2 from a lactate step test.
ui.res.no_weight: The body weight is missing, so W/kg is not shown.
ui.res.self_paced_tip: Measured mean power of the stage. The thresholds are computed on it, not on the target.
ui.res.off_target_tip: The measured mean power was more than 5 % from the target. The thresholds are computed on what was held.
ui.res.stages_hint_power: Double-click the power, lactate or RPE to correct a value. Write in the mean power from the monitor when the equipment did not give it. The curve is recalculated at once.
ui.res.manual_tip: * The mean power was written in by hand. The program had {auto} W. Empty the cell to bring that back.
ui.res.drag_pm5: Read from the monitor during the test. Keep the same damper setting, and drag factor, between tests that are to be compared.
ui.res.drag_missing: The monitor gave none. Write in what the monitor shows, and it goes into the report.
ui.res.drag_bad: The drag factor is a whole number between {low} and {high}.
ui.res.no_own_test: This athlete has no max HR test or lactate test of their own in {sport}. The zones are therefore built only on the highest heart rate of this test. Zones and max HR from another sport are not used: the difference is personal. A test in the sport gives real zones.
ui.wiz.kind_sub.bike: The tests in watt run on the trainer and are not filmed. Bike fit is filmed and is a test of its own.
ui.wiz.kind_sub.skierg: The tests in watt run on the SkiErg and are not filmed. Double poling technique is filmed and is a test of its own.
ui.wiz.pause_hint_power: 0 = the sample is taken without a pause.
ui.kind.bike.bikefit.desc: The rider is filmed on the trainer from the side and the front: knee, hip and trunk through the pedal stroke, and proposals for saddle, cleats and stem
ui.kind.skierg.ski.desc: The athlete is filmed from the side: the phases of the stroke, the trunk, the arms and the rhythm
ui.wiz.view_hint.bikefit: The side camera stands square to the bike, 3–4 m away at hip height (90–100 cm), with the whole rider and both wheels in the picture. A second camera from the front at knee height (60–80 cm), 2.5–3.5 m ahead of the front wheel, gives the knees' track. GoPro in Linear, not Wide, and at least 60 frames per second.
ui.wiz.view_hint.ski: The camera stands square to the plane of the stroke, 3–4 m away at hip height (100–110 cm), with the floor and the hands at their highest in the picture. Tape the place of the feet, so that tests can be compared. GoPro in Linear, not Wide, and at least 60 frames per second.
ui.wiz.need_camera.bikefit: Bike fit needs a camera from the side.
ui.wiz.need_camera.ski: Double poling needs a camera from the side.
ui.wiz.fps_low: {name} gives {fps} frames per second. Below 60 the measurement is marked uncertain: set the camera to 60 or 120 frames per second.
ui.wiz.demo_cyclist_front: Demo rider from the front (no camera needed)
ui.check.no_front_camera: No camera from the front: the knees' track is not measured and the cleats get no proposal
ui.consent.no_film_technique: {name} has not consented to film. Bike fit and double poling are measured from the film only, so the test cannot be done. The consent is changed under Athletes.
ui.res.tech_no_film: The test has no film to analyse. The film is recorded from the first stage after the warm-up.
ui.wiz.framing_sub.bikefit: The whole rider should be inside the frame from the side, with both wheels, and from the pedals to the shoulders from the front.
ui.wiz.framing_sub.ski: The whole athlete should be inside the frame, from the floor to the hands at their highest.
ui.plan.title: Training plan
ui.plan.test_hint: The zones of the plan come from this test. The latest lactate, max heart rate or zones test is preselected.
ui.plan.no_test: No test (zone and effort, or the max heart rate)
ui.plan.recent_hint: Running on average over the last 4–6 weeks. Leave empty if you do not know, and the plan starts at the level's default.
ui.plan.time_hint: Minutes available each day, and a clock time if the workout should have a time in the calendar. Leave the day empty if it cannot be used.
ui.plan.mode_goal: The plan ends with a goal (a race)
ui.plan.milestones: Milestones and training races on the way (optional):
ui.plan.weeks_hint: At least 4 weeks. The plan ends with a new test.
ui.plan.start_hint: The plan begins on the first Monday on or after this date. Empty means today.
ui.plan.health_hint: All three boxes must be ticked before the plan is printed, saved as PDF or as a calendar file. The declaration is valid for 12 months.
ui.plan.health.asked: The athlete has answered the health questions: heart, chest pain, dizziness, medication, pregnancy and injuries.
ui.plan.health.cleared: None of the answers stands in the way of training, or a doctor has said yes to it.
ui.plan.health.advice: The athlete knows that the plan is training advice and not health care, and that the workout is stopped and care is contacted on chest pain, dizziness or abnormal breathlessness.
ui.plan.health_expired: The declaration from {date} is older than 12 months. Go through the questions again.
ui.plan.empty: Fill in the form and press Preview, and the plan is shown here.
ui.plan.stale: The form has changed. Press Preview to see the new plan.
ui.plan.retested_note: Laid on a new test on {date}. Workouts before that day keep the targets of the test {before}.
ui.plan.delete_confirm: Delete the training plan for {name}? The tests are kept.
ui.plan.retest_offer: There is a newer test: {test} {date}. Lay the rest of the plan on the new zones? The workouts stay on their days.
ui.plan.retest_done: The plan is updated. From {date} the workouts have heart rate and pace targets from the new test. No workout has changed its day.
ui.plan.res_none: Build a training plan on this test.
ui.plan.res_same: The athlete's training plan is built on this test.
ui.plan.res_other: The athlete has a training plan built on another test.
ui.plan.res_retest: {name} has a training plan built on the test of {date}. Lay the rest of the plan on the new zones? The workouts stay on their days.
ui.plan.err_minutes: {day}: state between {lo} and {hi} minutes, or leave the day empty.
ui.plan.err_clock_without_minutes: {day} has a time but no minutes.
ui.plan.err_goal_name: Give the goal and every milestone a name.
ui.plan.err_weeks: State the length of the plan in weeks, at most {hi}.
ui.plan.err_health: Tick the three boxes of the health declaration before the plan is handed out.
ui.plan.err_ics: The calendar file could not be saved: {detail}
